mechanism: Betamethasone increases renal potassium wasting and sodium retention, while chlorthalidone also causes potassium depletion and hyponatremia, leading to additive electrolyte disturbances and increased hypokalemia risk.
action: Monitor serum potassium, sodium, and glucose levels regularly; consider potassium supplementation or concurrent use of potassium-sparing agent; monitor blood pressure and fluid status.
